renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: complexity_ribbon
  title: Expected distinct molecules by depth
  description: |-
    Each curve is a library: the number of distinct molecules preseq expects to see at a given sequencing depth, with the confidence interval as a band. It answers whether sequencing deeper would still add new molecules.
    How to read: a curve still rising steeply means the library is far from exhausted and resequencing pays off. A curve that has flattened is exhausted, so more reads return duplicates. A wide band means the extrapolation is uncertain, so be careful recommending deeper sequencing from it.
    Note: preseq extrapolates from the reads already sequenced, and the further it goes past that depth the less reliable it is. It publishes no cut-off for a sufficient library.
    Source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23435259/ and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smithlabcode/preseq/master/README.md
  kind: profile
  config:
    x_title: Total reads sequenced
    y_title: Expected distinct molecules
    legend_pos: bottom
  roles:
    series: sample
    x: total_reads
    y: expected_distinct
    lower: lower_ci
    upper: upper_ci

- component: figure
  title: Expected distinct molecules by depth
  description: |-
    Each line is a library: the expected distinct molecules at each sequencing depth, without the interval. It answers how the libraries compare in complexity.
    How to read: a line that stays closer to the diagonal at low depth has few duplicates so far. Lines that part early belong to libraries of very different complexity.
    Source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23435259/
  visu_type: line
  dict_kwargs:
    x: total_reads
    y: expected_distinct
    color: sample
    title: Expected distinct molecules by sequencing depth
    labels:
      total_reads: Total reads sequenced
      expected_distinct: Expected distinct molecules
      sample: Library

- component: card
  title: Deepest expected yield
  description: |-
    The hero number is the largest expected distinct molecule count of any library at the deepest depth extrapolated, with the upper quartile and the median over all points next to it. It answers how rich the best library could become.
    How to read: the value depends on how far preseq extrapolated, so compare libraries only at the same depth.
  column: expected_distinct
  aggregation: max
  aggregations:
  - q3
  - median
  secondary_layout: compact
  caption: deepest prediction, with the upper quartile and the median

- component: card
  title: Conservative expected yield
  description: |-
    The hero number is the largest lower bound of the confidence interval, the yield preseq is confident the library reaches, with the median next to it. It answers what yield can be promised with caution.
    How to read: the gap between this and the deepest expected yield is the uncertainty of the extrapolation.
  column: lower_ci
  aggregation: max
  aggregations:
  - median
  secondary_layout: compact
  caption: conservative yield, with the median

- component: card
  title: Interval width
  description: |-
    The hero number is the widest confidence interval of any library, in molecules, with the median and the mean next to it. It answers how uncertain the extrapolation is.
    How to read: the width grows with depth, so a very wide interval means the extrapolation went far past the sequenced depth. Treat those predictions as indicative only.
  column: ci_width
  aggregation: max
  aggregations:
  - median
  - average
  secondary_layout: compact
  caption: widest interval, with the median and the mean

- component: card
  title: Extrapolated depth
  description: |-
    The hero number is the largest sequencing depth preseq extrapolated to, with the median depth of the grid next to it. It answers how far the predictions go.
    How to read: all the curve past the depth you really sequenced is a prediction. Read the interval width there before relying on it.
  column: total_reads
  aggregation: max
  aggregations:
  - median
  secondary_layout: compact
  caption: deepest depth, with the median

- component: table
  title: Complexity curve points
  description: |-
    Each row is a depth of one library: the expected distinct molecules, the confidence interval and its width. It answers the expected yield at an exact depth.
    How to read: find the depth you plan to sequence to and read the interval, not only the expected value.
